I am having really hard time understanding how Salivan marks Flag
limits. What is taught in RTM is, that if a important level is broken
and price hits a TG, then the kink created after breaking that important
 level, is a FL ( not as simple as that, but as a brief explanation.. )

Salivan simply marks the FLs, by stating if they hold price up or down.
He doesnt often mention the important level broken. I am wondering if
anyone can explain how he marks the FLs. I know it is his own way of
defining FLs.
